title: Fallback `rating_step` trace detail is mislabeled as "Rate Table Lookup" and renders empty (wrong field names read)
description: The second branch handles `detailType === "rate_table_lookup" || detailType === "rating_step"` and reads `detail.lookup_keys`, `detail.matched_row`, and `detail.default_used`. Those field names belong to the `rate_table_lookup` shape only. A `rating_step` detail produced by the backend fallback path emits `matched_key`, `matched` (a boolean), and `rate_value` — and crucially has NO `tables` array and NO `combined_outputs`. Such a detail fails the rich guard on line 37 (which requires `Array.isArray(detail.tables) || Array.isArray(detail.combined_outputs)`) and therefore falls into this `rate_table_lookup` branch. Because `lookup_keys` and `matched_row` are undefined for that shape, the panel renders with the wrong title ("Rate Table Lookup") and shows no key chips and no matched-row chip, silently dropping the `matched_key`/`rate_value`/`matched` information the user expects to see for a rating step.
evidence: Backend src/haute/_trace_enrichment.py lines 272-277 returns `{ "detail_type": "rating_step", "matched_key": ..., "rate_value": ..., "matched": ... }` with no `tables`/`combined_outputs`. In NodeDetailBlock.tsx, line 37 guard is false for this (no array fields), so line 41 `|| detailType === "rating_step"` matches; line 42 reads `detail.lookup_keys` (undefined for this shape) -> the `keys &&` block on line 47 is skipped; line 43 reads `detail.matched_row` (undefined; backend emits `matched`) -> line 54 `matched != null` is false. Net result: `<TraceDetailPanel title="Rate Table Lookup">` with empty body. Distinct shapes are confirmed by frontend/src/panels/trace/traceStoryView.ts:52-60 (treats `rate_table_lookup` as primary but routes generic `rating_step` via `hasRichRatingStepDetail`) and by the `rate_table_lookup` fixtures in TracePanel.enhanced.test.tsx:476-478 which carry `lookup_keys`/`matched_row`. The intended fix is to remove `|| detailType === "rating_step"` from line 41 so fallback rating_step details fall through to the generic JSON renderer (or are given a dedicated rating-step fallback panel reading `matched_key`/`rate_value`/`matched`).
